name: Beliathan

facts.text: Level 70, 100,000 health. It rises only when no prince or princess of Darkness Falls is alive: 'The tunnels rumble and shake..'.
Every player it kills rises where they fell as a Beliathan minion and attacks.
Players called it the worm and said it spawns after the princes (Allakhazam comments).

story: Beliathan is the thing that comes up when the court is empty. While a single prince or princess of Darkness Falls lives, it stays down in the deep tunnels where even the demons do not go; when the last of them dies, the tunnels rumble and shake, and the worm rises to see what killed its masters. It is less a demon than a hunger with a body, and those it kills do not stay dead in the ordinary way: they get up again where they fell, its creatures now, and turn on their friends.
legend: Kill all four princes and the tunnels shake: that is the worm coming. Everyone it kills gets up as one of its minions and attacks the raid, so a wipe on Beliathan snowballs. Do not die, and kill the minions fast if someone does.

phases.text: The fallen rise as Beliathan's creatures!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Beliathan is dead. The deep tunnels are still.
atmosphere.wake: The princes are dead. The tunnels rumble and shake.

briefing: beliathan turns our dead into its minions. dont die, kill minions on sight
